name: Zenseact Open Dataset (ZOD)
description: Large-scale multimodal autonomous driving dataset released by Zenseact (a subsidiary of Volvo Cars). Collected by a fleet of vehicles operating across 14 European countries covering over 500,000 km in 2 years. Features an 8-megapixel front-facing camera, Hesai high-density 128-beam LiDAR, and high-precision GNSS/IMU. Contains 100,000 curated frames annotated for 2D/3D bounding boxes, road condition classification, lane markings, and vulnerability classification under diverse European environments.
